examples.japanese: {内政|ないせい}に{干渉|かんしょう}する。
{内政|ないせい}{問題|もんだい}について{議論|ぎろん}が{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: The debate on domestic issues continued.

examples.japanese: {他国|たこく}の{内政|ないせい}に{口出|くちだ}しするべきではないという{意見|いけん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many hold the view that one should not meddle in the domestic affairs of other countries.

notes:
Refers to a country's internal governance and political matters, as opposed to foreign affairs ({外交|がいこう}). Often encountered in news and political commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内政|ないせい}{干渉|かんしょう}: interference in domestic affairs
- {内政|ないせい}{問題|もんだい}: domestic issue
- {内政|ないせい}に{口出|くちだ}しする: to meddle in internal affairs
- {内政|ないせい}{不干渉|ふかんしょう}: non-interference in domestic affairs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外交|がいこう}: foreign affairs, diplomacy — the counterpart to {内政|ないせい}
- {国内|こくない}{政治|せいじ}: domestic politics — a broader, more casual synonym
- {国政|こくせい}: national politics — covers both domestic and foreign aspects
